name: W Maldives
positioning: A private island resort in North Ari Atoll set on its own house reef, with overwater villas that have private pools and direct reef access, an overwater AWAY Spa and a resident marine biologist
best_for: Snorkelers and divers who want a house reef straight from their villa
Couples and friends who want an energetic island with water sports

facts.text: W Maldives is a private island resort in North Ari Atoll, set on a house reef.
The beach villas take their design cues from the island's mangroves and sit steps from the sand.
A two-bedroom beachfront villa has a private pool, an open-air balcony and its own slide.
Reef sharks and turtles can be found just off the resort.
Guided jet-ski tours go to nearby uninhabited islands.
SIP is an overwater cocktail bar with a Peruvian atmosphere and Nikkei bites.
The Whatever/Whenever team can arrange a speedboat ride to a private beach with a sunset dinner for two.
English is spoken by all staff.

highlights.text: Each overwater bungalow has direct access to the house reef.
Overwater villas have their own private pool.
AWAY Spa has private overwater treatment rooms.
Guests can snorkel the house reef on a tour with the resident marine biologist.
Gaathafushi is a small private island near the resort that guests can book, including for a romantic overnight stay.

considerations.text: Return seaplane transfers from Velana International Airport are mandatory and charged separately.
Conde Nast Traveler says the groove is younger than at other resorts, with water sports encouraged.

sources.title: W Maldives - Condé Nast Traveler review
